#### Oil & Gas

Our experience covers all types of subsurface data and encompasses all aspects of the subsurface
data management landscape.

[Learn More][224]

#### Low Carbon

We currently manage, store, and deliver the data required to evaluate and monitor reservoirs for
energy and carbon storage.

[Learn More][225]

#### Mining

Katalyst Data Management has been at the forefront of adapting and adopting oil and gas data
management practices for the minerals exploration industry. Since early 2023, we have been working
with mining operators, application vendors, and technology service providers to deploy and test at
scale enterprise level data platforms and architectures.

[Learn More][226]

## WHO WE ARE

## KATALYST DATA
## MANAGEMENT

Katalyst Data Management® provides the only integrated, end-to-end subsurface data management
solution for the oil and gas industry. Our employees operate in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific,
and South America and are dedicated to optimizing the value of subsurface data,
including seismic and well data.

Katalyst enables clients’ digital transformation of E&P data with
digitizing services and digital transformation consulting.
[ Learn More ][227]

## WHAT WE DO

## KATALYST SUBSURFACE
## DATA MANAGEMENT

Seismic and well data are critical assets for oil and gas companies. Katalyst Data Management® helps
you manage all of your geological and geophysical E&P data volumes with one multi-cloud solution to
unleash  your data’s potential for processing, interpretation and artificial intelligence.

Our full life cycle subsurface data management services include every step  in the process, from
data capture and verification, to cloud services and data organization, to marketing your
geophysical data online.
* Data capture and verification
* Cloud services and data organization
* Marketing your geophysical data online

## UnleashYour Data’s Potential

## WHAT WE PROVIDE

## Explore Our Services

#### Domain Knowledge

Our team of geological and geophysical data experts begin your E&P digital transformation, managing
and optimizing more subsurface data than any other provider worldwide.

#### Meta Data Integrity

Using smart data quality tools, the focus is to maintain the data integrity through the data
management process, so asset teams can trust the results are ready for analysis.

#### Digital Transformation

Digital transformation begins with proven data capture, scanning and tape transcription processes
and results in subsurface data with greater quality, visibility and access.

#### Multicloud Storage

Seismic cloud data solutions ensure secure access to your subsurface data assets, whether they’re
hosted at one of our datacenters or stored in a private cloud or multi-cloud environment.

#### Data Security / Data Recovery

We keep data secure with multiple independent servers and test and validate our secure web storage
with IBM penetration testing. Should data be compromised, Katalyst offers data recovery for all data
resources

#### 24/7 Data Access

Katalyst establishes real-time data analytics for subsurface data, granting faster access to data, a
longer lifespan for data and the ability to discover new value with big data analytics.

## MANAGEMENT

## DATA MANAGEMENT

Seismic and well data are critical assets for oil and gas companies. Katalyst Data Management® helps
you manage all of your geological and geophysical E&P data volumes with one multi-cloud solution to
unleash  your data’s potential for processing, interpretation and artificial intelligence.

Our full life cycle subsurface data management services include every step  in the process, from
data capture and verification, to cloud services and data organization, to marketing your
geophysical data online.

#### Domain Knowledge

Using smart data quality tools, the focus is to maintain the data integrity through the data
management process, so asset teams can trust the results are ready for analysis.

#### Digital Transformation

Digital transformation begins with proven data capture, scanning and tape transcription processes
and results in subsurface data with greater quality, visibility and access.

#### Multicloud Storage

Seismic cloud data solutions ensure secure access to your subsurface data assets, whether they’re
hosted at one of our datacenters or stored in a private cloud or multi-cloud environment.

We keep data secure with multiple independent servers and test and validate our secure web storage
with IBM penetration testing. Should data be compromised, Katalyst offers data recovery for all data
resources

longer lifespan for data and the ability to discover new value with big data analytics.

# Why AleAnna

[Leading the Energy Transition]

## Leading the Energy Transition

01

AleAnna is contributing to securing Italy’s and Europe’s energy future by delivering immediate,
reliable natural gas while advancing renewable natural gas (RNG) solutions. AleAnna is a
technology-driven energy company leveraging advanced technologies to optimize reservoir performance
and expand its renewable natural gas (RNG) portfolio. AleAnna has over 140,000 acres of owned 3D
seismic data to unlock Italy's natural gas reserves, supporting Europe’s sustainability and energy
security goals. Also, by turning organic waste into carbon-negative power and bridging cleaner
energy sources, AleAnna is paving the way for a sustainable and secure energy transition. 

[Powering Progress, Fueling Humanity]

### Powering Progress, Fueling Humanity

02

In a world short on energy, billions of people lack access to affordable, reliable, lower-carbon
energy, which is crucial to human flourishing. Addressing this crisis is one of today’s greatest
global challenges, and we believe natural gas is the best-positioned solution to answer that call.
By safely and responsibly delivering critical energy to markets in need, AleAnna will help address
one of the great threats to human prosperity. Centered in the Po Valley, AleAnna has $70 million
(PV10) of Proved Reserves; $90 million (PV10) of Probable Reserves; and $115 million (PV10) of
Possible Reserves. Moreover, 18 additional prospects have a mean estimate of .220 Tcf Prospective
Resources. 

[Building a Stronger, Greener Europe]

### Building a Stronger, Greener Europe

03

AleAnna’s total oil and gas holdings exceed 2.7 million acres (including approximately 400,000 acres
of licenses currently under suspension due to the Pitesai, whose formal repeal is pending. AleAnna’s
holdings include one production concession covering 6,600 acres, 15 applications (which can be
converted to licenses at AleAnna’s request) encompassing 1.8 million acres, and 13 permits totaling
940,000 acres. AleAnna owns 33.5% of Longanesi, Italy’s most significant onshore natural gas
discovery in over two decades. With three major Po Valley discoveries already made and fourteen
natural gas projects planned this decade, AleAnna plays a pivotal role in Italy’s energy transition.
The Po Valley's extensive infrastructure, featuring 33,000 kilometers of gas pipelines, three major
storage facilities, and over 60% of Italy’s RNG facilities, aligns with AleAnna’s commitment to
sustainability. 

[Innovating for a Sustainable Tomorrow]

### Innovating for a Sustainable Tomorrow

04

AleAnna’s RNG portfolio includes over 100 projects representing approximately €1.1 billion
investment and potential investment, including three operational projects; 8 projects in negotiation
with €80 million potential investment; 9 projects in due diligence with €100 million potential
investment; 7 projects in advanced evaluation with €90 million potential investment; and 73 projects
in early evaluation with €770 million potential investment. Integrating RNG into Italy’s pipelines
and supporting local farmers, these efforts enhance energy security, sustainability, and economic
growth across the region. 

[Harnessing Technology for a Net-Zero Future]

### Harnessing Technology for a Net-Zero Future

05

AleAnna's team of seasoned energy leaders, hailing from industry leaders such as Shell, Eni, and
Exxon, brings unparalleled expertise to the forefront of innovation. By leveraging advanced
technologies, including cutting-edge reservoir characterization, high-resolution seismic imaging and
processing, and sophisticated data analytics, AleAnna ensures efficient and sustainable energy
production. The company’s strategic approach prioritizes reducing carbon emissions while addressing
the increasing global demand for energy. With a commitment to innovation and responsible practices,
AleAnna develops and implements the technologies and systems necessary to drive progress for both
people and the planet. Through these efforts, AleAnna actively contributes to the global journey
toward net-zero emissions and lays the groundwork for a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

### 13

Exploration Permits Covering Over 940,000 Acres That Pave The Way For Future Growth In AleAnna’s
Conventi

# Why AleAnna

[Leading the Energy Transition]

## Leading the Energy Transition

01

AleAnna is contributing to securing Italy’s and Europe’s energy future by delivering immediate,
reliable natural gas while advancing renewable natural gas (RNG) solutions. AleAnna is a
technology-driven energy company leveraging advanced technologies to optimize reservoir performance
and expand its renewable natural gas (RNG) portfolio. AleAnna has over 140,000 acres of owned 3D
seismic data to unlock Italy's natural gas reserves, supporting Europe’s sustainability and energy
security goals. Also, by turning organic waste into carbon-negative power and bridging cleaner
energy sources, AleAnna is paving the way for a sustainable and secure energy transition. 

[Powering Progress, Fueling Humanity]

### Powering Progress, Fueling Humanity

02

In a world short on energy, billions of people lack access to affordable, reliable, lower-carbon
energy, which is crucial to human flourishing. Addressing this crisis is one of today’s greatest
global challenges, and we believe natural gas is the best-positioned solution to answer that call.
By safely and responsibly delivering critical energy to markets in need, AleAnna will help address
one of the great threats to human prosperity. Centered in the Po Valley, AleAnna has $70 million
(PV10) of Proved Reserves; $90 million (PV10) of Probable Reserves; and $115 million (PV10) of
Possible Reserves. Moreover, 18 additional prospects have a mean estimate of .220 Tcf Prospective
Resources. 

[Building a Stronger, Greener Europe]

### Building a Stronger, Greener Europe

03

AleAnna’s total oil and gas holdings exceed 2.7 million acres (including approximately 400,000 acres
of licenses currently under suspension due to the Pitesai, whose formal repeal is pending. AleAnna’s
holdings include one production concession covering 6,600 acres, 15 applications (which can be
converted to licenses at AleAnna’s request) encompassing 1.8 million acres, and 13 permits totaling
940,000 acres. AleAnna owns 33.5% of Longanesi, Italy’s most significant onshore natural gas
discovery in over two decades. With three major Po Valley discoveries already made and fourteen
natural gas projects planned this decade, AleAnna plays a pivotal role in Italy’s energy transition.
The Po Valley's extensive infrastructure, featuring 33,000 kilometers of gas pipelines, three major
storage facilities, and over 60% of Italy’s RNG facilities, aligns with AleAnna’s commitment to
sustainability. 

[Innovating for a Sustainable Tomorrow]

### Innovating for a Sustainable Tomorrow

04

AleAnna’s RNG portfolio includes over 100 projects representing approximately €1.1 billion
investment and potential investment, including three operational projects; 8 projects in negotiation
with €80 million potential investment; 9 projects in due diligence with €100 million potential
investment; 7 projects in advanced evaluation with €90 million potential investment; and 73 projects
in early evaluation with €770 million potential investment. Integrating RNG into Italy’s pipelines
and supporting local farmers, these efforts enhance energy security, sustainability, and economic
growth across the region. 

[Harnessing Technology for a Net-Zero Future]

### Harnessing Technology for a Net-Zero Future

05

AleAnna's team of seasoned energy leaders, hailing from industry leaders such as Shell, Eni, and
Exxon, brings unparalleled expertise to the forefront of innovation. By leveraging advanced
technologies, including cutting-edge reservoir characterization, high-resolution seismic imaging and
processing, and sophisticated data analytics, AleAnna ensures efficient and sustainable energy
production. The company’s strategic approach prioritizes reducing carbon emissions while addressing
the increasing global demand for energy. With a commitment to innovation and responsible practices,
AleAnna develops and implements the technologies and systems necessary to drive progress for both
people and the planet. Through these efforts, AleAnna actively contributes to the global journey
toward net-zero emissions and lays the groundwork for a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

# Video Production That Moves B2B Forward.

**We help Houston B2B marketing teams create video content that drives marketing, sales, recruiting,
and internal communication.**

[ Start Your Video ][28]

## How Companies Work With Anthem

Start with a single video, scale with an on-demand Houston video production partner, or launch a
video podcast that positions your company as the expert in your market.
 

#### Video Production

## Make Video Your Competitive Advantage.

Video isn’t optional. It’s how buyers pay attention, learn new ideas, and decide who to trust.

Whether you need a high-impact single project, a branded video podcast, or a retained production
partner, we help B2B teams create video that supports sales, recruiting, and internal alignment —
without the friction of the traditional project model.

As a Houston-based B2B video production and podcast studio, we work with growth-focused companies
that want video to be consistent, professional, and built to scale.

About This Site
Data sources, methodology & attribution

## Live Earthquake Map

Real-time seismic events from around the world, updated every minute.

📡
Data Source
All earthquake data is provided in real-time by the **United States Geological Survey (USGS)**
Earthquake Hazards Program via their public GeoJSON feeds and FDSN event API. Data is fetched live
and refreshed every 60 seconds.

[USGS GeoJSON Feeds →][100]
🗺️
Map Technology
Interactive maps are powered by **MapLibre GL JS**, an open-source WebGL mapping library. Map tiles
are served by **OpenFreeMap** using the Positron (light) and Dark styles.

[MapLibre GL →][101] [OpenFreeMap →][102]
🔢
Magnitude Scale
Magnitudes shown are as reported by USGS, using the **moment magnitude scale (Mw)** where available,
or the best available magnitude type (ML, mb, Ms) for each event. The moment magnitude scale is the
modern replacement for the Richter scale – each whole number increase represents about 32 times more
energy release.

M 0–2.9 Minor — rarely feltM 3–3.9 Light — often felt, rarely damagingM 4–4.9 Moderate — felt
widelyM 5–5.9 Strong — can cause damageM 6+ Major — serious damage potential
📍
Location Detection
Country and region attribution uses a three-layer approach: **(1)** keyword matching against USGS
place descriptions, **(2)** coordinate bounding box lookup covering 90+ countries, and **(3)**
[Nominatim][103] reverse geocoding (OpenStreetMap) for offshore and ambiguous events.

Deep-ocean events with no nearby landmass may remain unattributed — this is correct behaviour.
🕐
Time Windows
The live feed shows earthquakes across four windows: past hour, past 24 hours, past 7 days, and past
30 days. The Timeline tab uses the USGS historical FDSN API and goes back to **1900**, with
configurable magnitude thresholds.

All times are displayed in your local browser timezone.
⚠️
Disclaimer
Independent tool – not affiliated with USGS or any government agency. Data may be preliminary or
revised.

**Do not use for emergency decisions.** For alerts, consult [earthquake.usgs.gov][104].
Data © [USGS][105] · Maps © [OpenFreeMap][106] / [OpenStreetMap][107] · Geocoding © [Nominatim][108]

## Frequently Asked Questions About Earthquakes

### ❓ What causes earthquakes?

Earthquakes are caused by the sudden release of energy along fault lines when tectonic plates move.
Most earthquakes occur at plate boundaries, where plates either collide (convergent boundaries),
pull apart (divergent boundaries), or slide past each other (transform boundaries). The build‑up of
stress over time causes rocks to break, releasing seismic waves that shake the ground. Human
activities like mining, reservoir filling, and fracking can also induce small earthquakes.
**Intraplate earthquakes** occur far from plate boundaries, like in Australia or Brazil. The point
where the rupture starts is called the hypocenter, and the location directly above it on the surface
is the epicenter.

### ❓ What was the biggest earthquake ever recorded?

The largest earthquake ever recorded was the [1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile][109], with a
magnitude of 9.5 on the moment magnitude scale. It struck on May 22, 1960, and caused a devastating
tsunami that affected the entire Pacific basin, reaching as far as Hawaii, Japan, and the
Philippines. The earthquake itself lasted about 10 minutes, and the tsunami killed thousands of
people. Other notable great earthquakes include the 1964 Great Alaska earthquake (M9.2), the 2004
Sumatra‑Andaman earthquake (M9.1–9.3), and the [2011 Tōhoku earthquake in Japan][110] (M9.1).

### ❓ Should I get earthquake insurance?

If you live in a seismically active region (California, Japan, Turkey, Chile, Indonesia, the Pacific
Northwest of the USA, etc.), earthquake insurance can protect your home and belongings. Standard
homeowners policies usually exclude earthquake damage. Typical earthquake insurance covers dwelling,
personal property, and additional living expenses. However, deductibles are often high (10–25% of
the policy limit). Review your risk with a local agent. Even in low‑risk areas, a moderate
earthquake can cause expensive damage. Many experts recommend earthquake insurance if you can afford
the premium – it's a relatively low cost for peace of mind.

### 📊 How many earthquakes happen every day?

On average, the USGS detects about **50 to 80 earthquakes per day** globally — that's roughly 20,000
to 30,000 per year. Most are small (magnitude < 3) and go unnoticed. On any given day, there are
typically 5–15 earthquakes of magnitude 5 or larger, and about 1–3 magnitude 6+ events per week. You
can see the live count on our stats bar above.

### 🌏 What is the Ring of Fire?

The Ring of Fire is a horseshoe‑shaped zone around the Pacific Ocean where about **90% of the
world's earthquakes** occur. It spans 40,000 km and includes active subduction zones, volcanic arcs,
and oceanic trenches. Countries like Japan, Indonesia, Chile, the Philippines, and the US (Alaska,
California) lie on it. Learn more about earthquakes in [Japan][111], [Chile][112], and [the

About This Site
Data sources, methodology & attribution

## Live Earthquake Map

Real-time seismic events from around the world, updated every minute.

📡
Data Source
All earthquake data is provided in real-time by the **United States Geological Survey (USGS)**
Earthquake Hazards Program via their public GeoJSON feeds and FDSN event API. Data is fetched live
and refreshed every 60 seconds.

[USGS GeoJSON Feeds →][100]
🗺️
Map Technology
Interactive maps are powered by **MapLibre GL JS**, an open-source WebGL mapping library. Map tiles
are served by **OpenFreeMap** using the Positron (light) and Dark styles.

[MapLibre GL →][101] [OpenFreeMap →][102]
🔢
Magnitude Scale
Magnitudes shown are as reported by USGS, using the **moment magnitude scale (Mw)** where available,
or the best available magnitude type (ML, mb, Ms) for each event. The moment magnitude scale is the
modern replacement for the Richter scale – each whole number increase represents about 32 times more
energy release.

M 0–2.9 Minor — rarely feltM 3–3.9 Light — often felt, rarely damagingM 4–4.9 Moderate — felt
widelyM 5–5.9 Strong — can cause damageM 6+ Major — serious damage potential
📍
Location Detection
Country and region attribution uses a three-layer approach: **(1)** keyword matching against USGS
place descriptions, **(2)** coordinate bounding box lookup covering 90+ countries, and **(3)**
[Nominatim][103] reverse geocoding (OpenStreetMap) for offshore and ambiguous events.

Deep-ocean events with no nearby landmass may remain unattributed — this is correct behaviour.
🕐
Time Windows
The live feed shows earthquakes across four windows: past hour, past 24 hours, past 7 days, and past
30 days. The Timeline tab uses the USGS historical FDSN API and goes back to **1900**, with
configurable magnitude thresholds.

All times are displayed in your local browser timezone.
⚠️
Disclaimer
Independent tool – not affiliated with USGS or any government agency. Data may be preliminary or
revised.

**Do not use for emergency decisions.** For alerts, consult [earthquake.usgs.gov][104].
Data © [USGS][105] · Maps © [OpenFreeMap][106] / [OpenStreetMap][107] · Geocoding © [Nominatim][108]

## Frequently Asked Questions About Earthquakes

### ❓ What causes earthquakes?

Earthquakes are caused by the sudden release of energy along fault lines when tectonic plates move.
Most earthquakes occur at plate boundaries, where plates either collide (convergent boundaries),
pull apart (divergent boundaries), or slide past each other (transform boundaries). The build‑up of
stress over time causes rocks to break, releasing seismic waves that shake the ground. Human
activities like mining, reservoir filling, and fracking can also induce small earthquakes.
**Intraplate earthquakes** occur far from plate boundaries, like in Australia or Brazil. The point
where the rupture starts is called the hypocenter, and the location directly above it on the surface
is the epicenter.

### ❓ What was the biggest earthquake ever recorded?

The largest earthquake ever recorded was the [1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile][109], with a
magnitude of 9.5 on the moment magnitude scale. It struck on May 22, 1960, and caused a devastating
tsunami that affected the entire Pacific basin, reaching as far as Hawaii, Japan, and the
Philippines. The earthquake itself lasted about 10 minutes, and the tsunami killed thousands of
people. Other notable great earthquakes include the 1964 Great Alaska earthquake (M9.2), the 2004
Sumatra‑Andaman earthquake (M9.1–9.3), and the [2011 Tōhoku earthquake in Japan][110] (M9.1).

### ❓ Should I get earthquake insurance?

If you live in a seismically active region (California, Japan, Turkey, Chile, Indonesia, the Pacific
Northwest of the USA, etc.), earthquake insurance can protect your home and belongings. Standard
homeowners policies usually exclude earthquake damage. Typical earthquake insurance covers dwelling,
personal property, and additional living expenses. However, deductibles are often high (10–25% of
the policy limit). Review your risk with a local agent. Even in low‑risk areas, a moderate
earthquake can cause expensive damage. Many experts recommend earthquake insurance if you can afford
the premium – it's a relatively low cost for peace of mind.

### 📊 How many earthquakes happen every day?

On average, the USGS detects about **50 to 80 earthquakes per day** globally — that's roughly 20,000
to 30,000 per year. Most are small (magnitude < 3) and go unnoticed. On any given day, there are
typically 5–15 earthquakes of magnitude 5 or larger, and about 1–3 magnitude 6+ events per week. You
can see the live count on our stats bar above.

### 🌏 What is the Ring of Fire?

The Ring of Fire is a horseshoe‑shaped zone around the Pacific Ocean where about **90% of the
world's earthquakes** occur. It spans 40,000 km and includes active subduction zones, volcanic arcs,
and oceanic trenches. Countries like Japan, Indonesia, Chile, the Philippines, and the US (Alaska,
California) lie on it. Learn more about earthquakes in [Japan][111], [Chile][112], and [the
Philippines][113] o

# User manual

## 1. The earthquakes in the LastQuake app are categorized by color:

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Earthquake not known to be felt.                                                                   
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Felt earthquake. No location and no magnitude yet.                                                 
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Earthquake felt locally and/or low shaking level. No damage expected.                              
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Earthquake felt at larger distances. Shaking can be locally strong. No significant damage expected.
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Widely felt earthquake with strong local shaking. Possibility of local and/or minor damage.        
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Major felt earthquake and strong shaking level. Damage to be expected at short epicentral distances
and/or for sub-standard buildings.                                                                 
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Earthquake known to be destructive.                                                                
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Center (PTWC).

(PTWC).                                                                                            
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Tsunami Information or Tsunami Warning issued by the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center. The icon can  
be associated to any of the above colors.                                                          
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Tsunami evaluation in progress. More information to come. The icon can be associated to any of the 
above colors.                                                                                      
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
No tsunami risk. The icon can be associated to any of the above colors.                            
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by explosion.                                                                    
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by drilling.                                                                     
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by landslide.                                                                    
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by meteorite.                                                                    
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by sonic boom.                                                                   
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Shaking triggered by volcano eruption.                                                             
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## 2. Pics and videos of interest

We are looking for pictures about earthquakes's impacts:
* Damage within its context (buildings, bridges, roads,... not too close up);
* Effects on landscapes (landslides, liquefactions, ground's failures...);
* While respecting people dignity.

Please send only images that you shoot yourself. The EMSC respects copyright laws.

## 3. Geolocation and notifications

The geolocation used by our notification service is your geolocation from the last time you opened
the LastQuake app.

# information channels

### @LastQuake

Official EMSC X channel where to find rapid earthquake information as well as educational tweets
about seismology and earthquake preparedness.

### @lastquake.emsc.eu

Official EMSC BlueSky channel where to find rapid earthquake information as well as educational
tweets about seismology and earthquake preparedness.

### Telegram Bot

The EMSC now operates a Telegram Bot; it is free and add free, and will allow you to receive
personalized information about felt earthquakes around you! - Join the service @LastQuake at
https://t.me/lastquake_bot.

### Desktop

EMSC website for desktop where to find rapid earthquake information and testimonies from the
eyewitnesses, as well as in-depth information about the EMSC.

### Mobile

EMSC website for desktop where to find rapid earthquake information and testimonies from the
eyewitnesses, as well as in-depth information about the EMSC.

### LastQuake app

Free and ad-free mobile application informing citizens in case of an earthquake and gathering their
testimonies in the aftermath via comments, pictures, and videos.

### Messenger Bot

The EMSC now operates a Messenger Bot; it is free and add free, and will allow you to receive
personalized information about felt earthquakes around you! - Join the service directly in Messenger
(mobile or desktop) at https://m.me/LastQuakeBot.

# donate

# Would you like to support us?

We are a non-profit, non governmental organization. We offer free and ad-free services. Thanks to
your help we can further the collective knowledge on earthquake and their mitigation.

## Select your gift amount

10 €

More€

Make your payment by CB card or PayPal!

**Donor Privacy Policy**
We do not share, sell, or trade your personal information with anyone.

## 2. Pics and videos of interest

We are looking for pictures about earthquakes's impacts:
* Damage within its context (buildings, bridges, roads,... not too close up);
* Effects on landscapes (landslides, liquefactions, ground's failures...);
* While respecting people dignity.

Please send only images that you shoot yourself. The EMSC respects copyright laws.

ryzyka eksploracyjnego. Zastosowanie technologii sejsmicznych sektorze upstream pomaga firmom
energetycznym skuteczniej eksplorować i eksploatować złoża węglowodorów.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][49]
Obszary biznesowe **Energia Geotermalna**

Poszukiwania złóż geotermalnych wiążą się ze znacznym ryzykiem wynikającym z nieznajomości wgłębnej
budowy geologicznej. Kluczowym elementem każdej inwestycji geotermalnej jest więc właściwa
lokalizacja instalacji, która gwarantowałaby odpowiednie parametry hydrogeotermiczne ujęcia wody.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][50]
Obszary biznesowe **Morska Energetyka Wiatrowa**

Charakterystyka geologiczna i geotechniczna jest niezmiernie ważna przy projektowaniu fundamentów
morskich turbin wiatrowych. Dzieje się tak, ponieważ instalacje farm wiatrowych bez uprzedniej
inspekcji podłoża mogą zostać zniszczone przez procesy hydrodynamiczne aktywowane przez działanie
wiatru i fal.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][51]
Obszary biznesowe **Infrastruktura, Energetyka Jądrowa i Górnictwo**

Kompleksowe badanie gruntu jest niezbędne zarówno w budownictwie infrastrukturalnym, jak
i w budownictwie kolejowym, drogowym, tunelowym czy przemyśle wydobywczym. Właściwa ocena
przydatności gruntu do każdego projektu budowlanego pomaga w przygotowaniu dokładnych planów
operacyjnych i podejmowania świadomych decyzji inwestycyjnych.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][52]

Obszary biznesowe **Upstream**

Badania sejsmiczne są niezbędne do zrozumienia geologii basenów sedymentacyjnych i zmniejszenia
ryzyka eksploracyjnego. Zastosowanie technologii sejsmicznych sektorze upstream pomaga firmom
energetycznym skuteczniej eksplorować i eksploatować złoża węglowodorów.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][49]
Obszary biznesowe **Energia Geotermalna**

Poszukiwania złóż geotermalnych wiążą się ze znacznym ryzykiem wynikającym z nieznajomości wgłębnej
budowy geologicznej. Kluczowym elementem każdej inwestycji geotermalnej jest więc właściwa
lokalizacja instalacji, która gwarantowałaby odpowiednie parametry hydrogeotermiczne ujęcia wody.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][50]
Obszary biznesowe **Morska Energetyka Wiatrowa**

Charakterystyka geologiczna i geotechniczna jest niezmiernie ważna przy projektowaniu fundamentów
morskich turbin wiatrowych. Dzieje się tak, ponieważ instalacje farm wiatrowych bez uprzedniej
inspekcji podłoża mogą zostać zniszczone przez procesy hydrodynamiczne aktywowane przez działanie
wiatru i fal.

[CZYTAJ WIĘCEJ][51]
Obszary biznesowe **Infrastruktura, Energetyka Jądrowa i Górnictwo**

Kompleksowe badanie gruntu jest niezbędne zarówno w budownictwie infrastrukturalnym, jak
i w budownictwie kolejowym, drogowym, tunelowym czy przemyśle wydobywczym. Właściwa ocena
przydatności gruntu do każdego projektu budowlanego pomaga w przygotowaniu dokładnych planów
operacyjnych i podejmowania świadomych decyzji inwestycyjnych.

[Read More][72]

[Automated seismic node deployment and retrieval systems for field efficiency.]

## Automation

## Stealth
## Deployment

[Low-impact seismic node deployment with minimal environmental disturbance.]

## Stealth Deployment

[Low-impact seismic node deployment with minimal environmental disturbance.]

NuSeis Stealth. More and more customers want their nodes planted in the ground with little or no
surface exposure. This stealth approach to receiver deployments can not only provide you better data
because the node is not picking up any material surface wind or mechanical noise, it also enables
the sensors to go undetected by local populations. Recently on a project in Africa, NuSeis nodes
went undisturbed and unnoticed by villagers while the competitors’ nodes were stolen, chopped up and
vandalized, costing a great deal of data degradation, repair costs, and costly crew downtime. Nodes
can be customized further according to client needs.

## Strength and
## Reliability
##  

[Durable seismic equipment designed for harsh field environments.]

## Strength and Reliability

[Durable seismic equipment designed for harsh field environments.]

NuSeis = Strength and Reliability. Our engineers have driven over our nodes with trucks and
vibrators, have had when field fires passed over field deployed NRUs, have submerged them to over
2000 ft of water depth pressure, and our NuSeis NRUs did not fail. Don’t accept cheap plastic nodes
that will have moisture and dirt destroying node life and reliability. Buy long life asset,
ultra-strong NuSeis!

## Near Real
## Time QC

[Real-time seismic data quality control and monitoring in the field.]

## Near Real Time QC

[Real-time seismic data quality control and monitoring in the field.]

Near Real Time QC. NuSeis reliability is extraordinary. NuSeis customers have consistently achieved
less than 1% data losses on seismic surveys. At the same time, they opportunistically obtain health
and status from the nodes effortlessly! NuSeis NRUs broadcast “health and status” twice per second
which can be opportunistically captured in the field and uploaded through NuWeb to NuCenter. Don’t
accept dumb nodes that don’t provide real time status.

## Earthgrip
## Coupling

[EarthGrip coupling technology improving seismic data quality and ground contact.]

Another extraordinary single attribute of the NuSeis technology is our amazing EarthGrip ground
coupling. While our competitors lay their equipment on the ground or dig holes to place their nodes
at or below the ground surface. With NuSeis you simply “Solution the soil” by laterally compressing
the small ground cavity, and then you press the NuSeis formfactor into the ground! The lateral
forces provide a tight frictional bond that enables more optimal signal (ground displacement)
transfer into the geophone and prohibits mechanical resonance, so you record much less surface
noises.  NuSeis naturally and consistently provides exceptional data every time.  NuSeis deployment
is also perfectly environmentally friendly as the soil elasticity closes the hole back after
removing the NRU, leaving no environmental disturbance.
 

[Read More][73]

## Earthgrip
## Coupling

[EarthGrip coupling technology improving seismic data quality and ground contact.]
[Illustration of NuSeis transformation system with multiple seismic node configurations connected to
modular eCab core]

Make NuSeis YourSeis! Choose a NuSeis formfactor that is optimal for your upcoming project. The
NuSeis modular electronic eCab inside our NRU weighs 58 grams and can be removed from one NRU and
inserted into another formfactor in 2 minutes. This enables NuSeis operators to mechanically
transform their NuSeis nodal technology on a project-by-project basis into the formfactor that
enables peak operating performance in every terrain and optimal EarthGrip coupling in every surface
environment. This also enables our customers to maximize asset utilization, avoiding unnecessary
shipping costs, and ensuring the optimal geophone, the optimal battery duration, and the Lexan NRU
housing that optimizes ground coupling and delivers peak operating performance. Shipping only the
58-gram eCab also greatly reduces shipping cost for repair and return.  When you have a seismic
project challenge, let GTI provide you a NuSeis custom solution for your specific project
environment and operating methodology.  Make NuSeis YouSeis!

[Modular seismic node system adaptable for multiple survey environments.]

#### Transformation

## Transformation

## External Connectors

[Seismic nodes with internal geophones and external sensor connectivity options]

Internal Geophone Vs External Connectors. NuSeis nodes can be quickly and inexpensively converted
from an internal geophone to an external sensor or sensor array. In 60 seconds, you can swap the
NRU’s internal geophone lower end to a KCK connector lower end.

[Seismic nodes with internal geophones and external sensor connectivity options.]

## Internal Geophones or External Connectors

[Advanced seismic node navigation and self-positioning using DGPS technology.]
[Advanced seismic node navigation and self-positioning using DGPS technology.]

#### NuSite Navigation

NuSeis Navigation. The NuSeis EcoSystem includes “NuSite” navigation which eliminates the need to
survey and stake receiver points. NuSite lowers cost, reduces field tracks, and minimizes
environmental impact by eliminating receiver stakes and monumentation that are costly and wasteful.
You will never have to “trash a line” if you didn’t stake it in the first place.

## NuSite
## Navigation

Broad Instantaneous Dynamic Range and Low Noise Floor. High quality analog to digital circuitry is
fundamental to high quality seismic data recording. GTI spares no expense for its NuSeis technology
when selecting the state-of-the-art. Maxim A/D converter (MAX11216) with 148 dB of instantaneous
dynamic range. Others buy dated chips that run with degraded quality in low power mode, but the
results are not the same.

#### Dynamic Range

accuracy X, Y, and Z coordinates directly from each deployed node. Don’t buy nodes that can’t tell
you exactly where they were in X, Y, Z space, or nodes that require an external survey to log the

“GTI’s NuSeis™ NRU are designed for automated handling.

and injury and environmental profile by using modern industrial automation to deploy and retrieve
the nodes in harsh environments.

[Read More][72]

[Automated seismic node deployment and retrieval systems for field efficiency.]

## Automation

## Stealth
## Deployment

[Low-impact seismic node deployment with minimal environmental disturbance.]

## Stealth Deployment

[Low-impact seismic node deployment with minimal environmental disturbance.]

NuSeis Stealth. More and more customers want their nodes planted in the ground with little or no
surface exposure. This stealth approach to receiver deployments can not only provide you better data
because the node is not picking up any material surface wind or mechanical noise, it also enables
the sensors to go undetected by local populations. Recently on a project in Africa, NuSeis nodes
went undisturbed and unnoticed by villagers while the competitors’ nodes were stolen, chopped up and
vandalized, costing a great deal of data degradation, repair costs, and costly crew downtime. Nodes
can be customized further according to client needs.

## Strength and
## Reliability
##  

[Durable seismic equipment designed for harsh field environments.]

## Strength and Reliability

[Durable seismic equipment designed for harsh field environments.]

NuSeis = Strength and Reliability. Our engineers have driven over our nodes with trucks and
vibrators, have had when field fires passed over field deployed NRUs, have submerged them to over
2000 ft of water depth pressure, and our NuSeis NRUs did not fail. Don’t accept cheap plastic nodes
that will have moisture and dirt destroying node life and reliability. Buy long life asset,
ultra-strong NuSeis!

## Near Real
## Time QC

[Real-time seismic data quality control and monitoring in the field.]

## Near Real Time QC

[Real-time seismic data quality control and monitoring in the field.]

Near Real Time QC. NuSeis reliability is extraordinary. NuSeis customers have consistently achieved
less than 1% data losses on seismic surveys. At the same time, they opportunistically obtain health
and status from the nodes effortlessly! NuSeis NRUs broadcast “health and status” twice per second
which can be opportunistically captured in the field and uploaded through NuWeb to NuCenter. Don’t
accept dumb nodes that don’t provide real time status.

## Earthgrip
## Coupling

[EarthGrip coupling technology improving seismic data quality and ground contact.]

Another extraordinary single attribute of the NuSeis technology is our amazing EarthGrip ground
coupling. While our competitors lay their equipment on the ground or dig holes to place their nodes
at or below the ground surface. With NuSeis you simply “Solution the soil” by laterally compressing
the small ground cavity, and then you press the NuSeis formfactor into the ground! The lateral
forces provide a tight frictional bond that enables more optimal signal (ground displacement)
transfer into the geophone and prohibits mechanical resonance, so you record much less surface
noises.  NuSeis naturally and consistently provides exceptional data every time.  NuSeis deployment
is also perfectly environmentally friendly as the soil elasticity closes the hole back after
removing the NRU, leaving no environmental disturbance.
 

[Read More][73]

## Earthgrip
## Coupling

[EarthGrip coupling technology improving seismic data quality and ground contact.]
[Illustration of NuSeis transformation system with multiple seismic node configurations connected to
modular eCab core]

Make NuSeis YourSeis! Choose a NuSeis formfactor that is optimal for your upcoming project. The
NuSeis modular electronic eCab inside our NRU weighs 58 grams and can be removed from one NRU and
inserted into another formfactor in 2 minutes. This enables NuSeis operators to mechanically
transform their NuSeis nodal technology on a project-by-project basis into the formfactor that
enables peak operating performance in every terrain and optimal EarthGrip coupling in every surface
environment. This also enables our customers to maximize asset utilization, avoiding unnecessary
shipping costs, and ensuring the optimal geophone, the optimal battery duration, and the Lexan NRU
housing that optimizes ground coupling and delivers peak operating performance. Shipping only the
58-gram eCab also greatly reduces shipping cost for repair and return.  When you have a seismic
project challenge, let GTI provide you a NuSeis custom solution for your specific project
environment and operating methodology.  Make NuSeis YouSeis!

[Modular seismic node system adaptable for multiple survey environments.]

#### NuSite Navigation

NuSeis Navigation. The NuSeis EcoSystem includes “NuSite” navigation which eliminates the need to
survey and stake receiver points. NuSite lowers cost, reduces field tracks, and minimizes
environmental impact by eliminating receiver stakes and monumentation that are costly and wasteful.
You will never have to “trash a line” if you didn’t stake it in the first place.

## NuSite
## Navigation

Broad Instantaneous Dynamic Range and Low Noise Floor. High quality analog to digital circuitry is
fundamental to high quality seismic data recording. GTI spares no expense for its NuSeis technology
when selecting the state-of-the-art. Maxim A/D converter (MAX11216) with 148 dB of instantaneous
dynamic range. Others buy dated chips that run with degraded quality in low power mode, but the
results are not the same.

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,

offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## iXL Seismic Processing Systems

**INTRODUCING iXL**

iXL is the most comprehensive and highest performance to cost value 3D and 2D, interactive and batch
commercial seismic software package available.  iXL gives superior performance in the field on
laptops or in the office utilizing powerful Linux workstations.  iXL follows our own internal
programming standards to produce an intuitive, user-friendly interactive interface with rapid high
resolution graphics.  Users can enjoy interactive seismic data analysis and processing in a
mouse-driven point-and-click environment.  iXL is equipped with a full range of 2D and 3D seismic
processing software from survey design through one-pass 3D post-stack migration.

## Developer

Ralph Gobeli has spent his career working at the intersection of seismic imaging and
high-performance computing. Early in his career—when seismic processing was among the largest
consumers of computational power in the world—he focused on the practical problem of transforming
massive volumes of raw seismic data into reliable images of the subsurface.

Mentored by signal-processing pioneer Sven Treitel, Ralph worked on the development and
implementation of advanced seismic algorithms, including adaptive filtering, F-X-Y deconvolution,
and transforms based on Fourier, Hilbert, Radon, and Tau-p methods. His work emphasized both
algorithmic rigor and computational efficiency, often reducing processing times from months to hours
on large supercomputing systems such as Cray, SGI, and Fujitsu platforms.

Building on that experience, Ralph led the development of **iXL**, a commercial seismic processing
system designed to bring advanced 2D and 3D seismic analysis into an integrated working environment.
Rather than separating algorithm development from day-to-day interpretation work, iXL was designed
so geophysicists could interact directly with processing workflows, visualize results quickly, and
iterate on complex datasets.

Across his work in seismic computing, Ralph has maintained a consistent focus on making complex
computational methods both faster and more usable for the scientists who rely on them. Below are
some of his major contributions to the field of seismic processing:

**Optimized Experimental Design in the Context of Seismic Full Waveform Inversion (ScienceDirect cha
pter page)**

[https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/chapter/bookseries/pii/S0065268717300018][17]
`

**SURVEY DESIGN**

Versatile software for geometry setup, analysis, and quality control for both pre- and post- survey
geometries.  Utilizing a powerful graphic interface, users can define all the necessary geometry
parameters with ease and efficiency.  Survey quality control using attribute overlays in conjunction
with cultural and geological model information on the land grid provides unparalleled confidence in
a survey geometry.  Of course, UKOOA and SEGP1 format files can be input for the geometry
definition.  The same module is used for both land and marine surveys in 2D and 3D.

**TRACE INDEXING**

Using the Trace Indexing feature, the user can readily obtain common-shot, common-receiver, CMP, or
any sort order records from any pre-stack disk data set.  Data can be resorted, sifted, or limited
on any user-specified header words.

**3D DATA VOLUME DISPLAY**

The 3D Data Cube Display is an innovative method of viewing, selecting, and performing quality
control on your 3D data volume.

**ADVANCED GEOPHYSICAL TECHNOLOGY**

iXL has a wide variety of advanced technology analysis algorithms, such as AVO analysis, Tau-P
Transform, Random Transform, F-X Deconvolution, 2D Pre and Post Stack Migration, 3D non-aliasing
DMO, 3D singles pass Post Stack Migration and many others.

**INTERACTIVE PROCESSING**

iXL offers both interactive and batch processing modes.  By using the interactive mode, parameter
tests and data analysis are performed on-screen to obtain the optimum processing parameters. 
Processing flows for the batch mode are set up and modified graphically with great ease.

**INTERACTIVE VELOCITY ANALYSIS**

iXL provides truly interactive 2D and 3D velocity analysis, giving the best stacking velocity
manipulation such as velocity map utilities including Cubic Display of your 3D Velocity Model.

**BUILT-IN REMOTE ACCESS**

iXL includes a built-in copy of ThinAnywhere to allow remote access to your seismic processing and
survey design. Collaborate with processors at remote locations or allow your customers to view the
progress.

**FINAL DISPLAYS**

iXL can produce high quality professional final paper or film displays with comprehensive
annotations, including velocity boxes, line intersections, well locations, and side label containing
all the pertinent processing information.

**iXL IS COST EFFICIENT!**

iXl allows multiple users per CPU, AT NO ADDITIONAL FEE.  iXL provides an excellent development
environment for our clients’ proprietary algorithms and integration with other vendor’s products.

**EXPERIENCED CUSTOMER SUPPORT**

iXL can tailor the amount of customer support you receive to your needs. It can include technical
inquiries, software maintenance, and training.  Experienced professionals are dedicated to providing
the best solutions for our clients.

**CONTACT US FOR MORE INFORMATION AND A FREE DEMO**

Ralph Gobeli [(LinkedIn: ralph-gobeli)][4]) — Research timeline / key contributions

**3-D seismic survey design as an optimization problem (The Leading Edge, DOI)**

[https://doi.org/10.1190/1.1438430 (Crossref Chooser)][6]

**3-D seismic survey design and linear v(z) (SEG 1997 Expanded Abstracts, DOI)**

9]

**Sloping event DMO amplitude (EAGE / EarthDoc, DOI)**

[https://www.earthdoc.org/content/papers/10.3997/2214-4609.201408884 (earthdoc.org)][10]

**Depth focusing reflection tomography with application to prestack depth migration (SEG 2000, DOI)*
*

[https://doi.org/10.1190/1.1816224 (Geoscience World)][11]

[https://www.earthdoc.org/content/papers/10.3997/2214-4609-pdb.131.GEN1997_A027 (earthdoc.org)][12]

**Geophysics and the Internet (2000, The Leading Edge)**

[https://pubs.geoscienceworld.org/seg/tle/article-abstract/19/8/877/59114/Geophysics-and-the-Interne
t (Geo Science World)][13]`

**PAPERS CITING THE PUBLICATIONS**

`**3D seismic survey design optimization (Vermeer, PDF)**

[https://3dsymsam.nl/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/Optimization.pdf][14]

**Bi-objective optimization for seismic survey design (Monsegny, GeoConvention 2018, PDF)**

[https://www.crewes.org/Documents/ConferenceAbstracts/2018/CSEG/Monsegny_CSEG_2018.pdf][15]

**Proposta metodológica de otimização… sísmica terrestre 3D (Porsani et al., PDF)**

[https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Milton-Porsani/publication/259678606_Proposta_metodologica_de_
otimizacao_de_parametros_de_aquisicao_de_sismica_terrestre_3D_Aplicacao_nas_bacias_sedimentares_bras
ileiras/links/00b7d52ffbf4272b90000000/Proposta-metodologica-de-otimizacao-de-parametros-de-aquisica
o-de-sismica-terrestre-3D-Aplicacao-nas-bacias-sedimentares-brasileiras.pdf][16]

**Optimized Experimental Design in the Context of Seismic Full Waveform Inversion (ScienceDirect cha
pter page)**

[https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/chapter/bookseries/pii/S0065268717300018][17]
`

**SURVEY DESIGN**

Versatile software for geometry setup, analysis, and quality control for both pre- and post- survey
geometries.  Utilizing a powerful graphic interface, users can define all the necessary geometry
parameters with ease and efficiency.  Survey quality control using attribute overlays in conjunction
with cultural and geological model information on the land grid provides unparalleled confidence in
a survey geometry.  Of course, UKOOA and SEGP1 format files can be input for the geometry
definition.  The same module is used for both land and marine surveys in 2D and 3D.

**TRACE INDEXING**

Using the Trace Indexing feature, the user can readily obtain common-shot, common-receiver, CMP, or
any sort order records from any pre-stack disk data set.  Data can be resorted, sifted, or limited
on any user-specified header words.

**3D DATA VOLUME DISPLAY**

The 3D Data Cube Display is an innovative method of viewing, selecting, and performing quality
control on your 3D data volume.

**ADVANCED GEOPHYSICAL TECHNOLOGY**

iXL has a wide variety of advanced technology analysis algorithms, such as AVO analysis, Tau-P
Transform, Random Transform, F-X Deconvolution, 2D Pre and Post Stack Migration, 3D non-aliasing
DMO, 3D singles pass Post Stack Migration and many others.

**INTERACTIVE PROCESSING**

iXL offers both interactive and batch processing modes.  By using the interactive mode, parameter
tests and data analysis are performed on-screen to obtain the optimum processing parameters. 
Processing flows for the batch mode are set up and modified graphically with great ease.

**INTERACTIVE VELOCITY ANALYSIS**

iXL provides truly interactive 2D and 3D velocity analysis, giving the best stacking velocity
manipulation such as velocity map utilities including Cubic Display of your 3D Velocity Model.

**BUILT-IN REMOTE ACCESS**

iXL includes a built-in copy of ThinAnywhere to allow remote access to your seismic processing and
survey design. Collaborate with processors at remote locations or allow your customers to view the
progress.

**FINAL DISPLAYS**

iXL can produce high quality professional final paper or film displays with comprehensive
annotations, including velocity boxes, line intersections, well locations, and side label containing
all the pertinent processing information.

**iXL IS COST EFFICIENT!**

iXl allows multiple users per CPU, AT NO ADDITIONAL FEE.  iXL provides an excellent development
environment for our clients’ proprietary algorithms and integration with other vendor’s products.

**EXPERIENCED CUSTOMER SUPPORT**

iXL can tailor the amount of customer support you receive to your needs. It can include technical
inquiries, software maintenance, and training.  Experienced professionals are dedicated to providing
the best solutions for our clients.

**CONTACT US FOR MORE INFORMATION AND A FREE DEMO**

# [Macroseismic Sensor Netzwerk][10]

[ [Macroseismic Sensor Netzwerk] ][11]

Ein low-cost Strong-Motion seismisches Netzwerk zur Quantifizierung der Bodenbewegung,
Diskriminierung seismischer Quellen und Präsentation der Ergebnisse für die Öffentlichkeit.

# [Skatespot Dokumentation][12]

[ [Skatespot Dokumentation] ][13]

Ich verwende Structure-from-Motion / Multi-View-Stereo um 3D Punktwolken von Skatespots zu erzeugen.
Das ist ein schöner Spielplatz zwischen visueller Dokumentation und Rekonstruktion.

# [psysmon][14]

[ [psysmon] ][15]

Eine seismologische Datenanalyse- und Methodenentwicklungs-Software die sich an nicht-routinemäßige
seismologische Experimente richtet.

# [m-aar Radio][16]

[ [m-aar Radio] ][17]

m-aar Radio ist ein Internet Radio Stream, der die Sonifikation seismischer Daten zu Verfügung
stellt.

# [MSS Jahresbericht 2022][18]

[[MSS Jahresbericht 2022]][19]

Ereignisse und Aktivitäten des MSS Netzwerks im Jahr 2022

Der MSS Jahresbericht 2022 gibt einen Überblick über die registrierten Ereignisse, die verwendeten
Auswertemethoden und Aktivitäten rund um das MSS Netzwerk. [**mehr lesen**][20]

# [Neue Publikationen][21]

[[Neue Publikationen]][22]

Ich war an einigen Veröffentlichungen beteiligt

Seit dem letzten Jahr war ich an einigen wissenschaftlichen Publikationen beteiligt. Zum einen gab
es einige Veröffentlichungen rund um das MSS Netzwerk, zum anderen wurden Ergebnisse von Monitoring
Projekten in Grönland veröffentlicht. [**mehr lesen**][23]

[[Glacioburst Sounds im Stadtradio Göttingen]][25]

Deutschen Theaters Göttingen im Stadtradio Göttingen behandelt. [**mehr lesen**][26]

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your

## FAQs

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

process. They maintain open lines of communication and offer personalized guidance, ensuring a

Carsten and his team were very thorough and helpful when it came time to apply for and get our
visas.  Because of that, once we submitted our paperwork immigration had everything they needed from
us and did not have to come back for more information.

They are now helping us with our resident visas, and I'm certain that the process will be the same.
 I'd recommend them highly.
[**K.J**][92]
We are very grateful to Maj for her diligence, brilliant mind and 'way with words'.

Carsten is thorough and direct - he will give you the correct advice and be honest about your

in Carsten and his team. Big Thanks, from Andre and Taaliah
[**A.K**][93]
NZIC was the only company in New Zealand that we could find with a comprehensive Job Search service!

They guided me all the way through getting my first work visa to permanent residency.

Their job seeking support was key when I first arrived in NZ, communication was always easy and
clear. I'm very thankful for their help and definitely recommend their services.
[**D.O**][94]
We will always be grateful to Carsten and all the team at NZIC.  Our emigration process was
particularly tricky and Carsten guided us all the way to a successful outcome.

Thank you all for being there, we are now living the dream. We would highly recommend their services
to anyone.

It took me/us 3 years of work to get me in the country but we finally made it. Actually, they did
the most and made a fantastic job. It is a great team, lovely people with lots of competence and
experience.

They know what they do, help you wherever they can and they are German speaking as well! I had a

From my point of view it is the best Advisor team all over the country and highly recommended. Try

## RAISING INDUSTRY STANDARDS IN GLOBAL EXPEDITED
## GEOPHYSICAL PROJECT DELIVERY.

Ocean Geophysics is an independent geophysical data processing consultancy offering a global 24hr
service.

With over 100 years of combined experience in the design, acquisition, processing, reporting and
delivery of geophysical surveys.

Specialising in the processing and interpretation of Side Scan Sonar, Magnetometry, Gravity, CSEM,
Sub Bottom Profiler, Multibeam and Seismic data.

# WE PROVIDE A COMPLETE GEOPHYSICAL SOLUTION
# TAILORED TO YOUR PROJECT NEEDS.

[WE PROVIDE A COMPLETE GEOPHYSICAL SOLUTION]

## BORN OF THE IDEA THAT THE BEST DELIVERABLES COME FROM
## PROJECTS HANDLED BY A SINGLE TEAM.

Our in-house Ocean team has been expertly crafted to encompass exceptionally talented and
well-trained team members, capable of working in every data set.

Spearheaded by Robert Morrow and Eric Joyce, the Ocean Geophysics team is currently over 60
full-time members strong. Giving us the ability to work on large projects seamlessly.

We support multiple vessels with complete geophysical spread acquisition, with the ability to
provide 24-hour support. Ensuring that your data acquisition is smooth while aiding in the
minimisation of vessel downtime.

To use time zones effectively and to our advantage, we moved the whole company to South East Asia,
putting us 6 hours ahead of Europe and at least 12 hours ahead of most of the US.

This strategic move means that during operations, most processing and interpretation for clients in
the West takes place overnight.

## WE PRIDE OURSELVES IN OUR TEAMS ABILITY TO PROCESS DATA IN REAL TIME.
## PROVIDING 24-HOUR SUPPORT WHEN REQUIRED.

[Ocean team provides real time data]

## SERVICES OVERVIEW.

## DATA PROCESSING.

Ocean Geophysics is a leading provider of comprehensive data processing services in the field of
geophysics. With extensive expertise in Acquisition, Processing, and Interpretation, we specialize
in handling a wide range of geophysical data types.

Our skilled team is proficient in processing and analyzing various data sets, including Single and
Multi-Channel Seismic, 2D UHRS, 3D UHRS, Side Scan Sonar, Magnetometer and Gradiometer (UXO survey),
EM63 / 61, FTG, Resistivity and ALARP. By utilising advanced techniques and cutting-edge technology,
we ensure accurate and reliable results for our clients. 

[ LEARN MORE ][17]
[DATA PROCESSING.]

## CLIENT REPRESENTATION.

In today’s epoch of accelerated technology and critical review of contractor performance, effective
client representation plays a pivotal role in offshore operations. Ocean Geophysics understands this
significance and offers a comprehensive range of offshore client representation services.

With industry-leading professionals and a client-led approach, we cover a broad spectrum of
requirements, providing assurance and confidence. Our experienced operatives, combined with our
global 24-hour support services, ensure seamless assistance and prompt response.

[ LEARN MORE ][18]
[CLIENT REPRESENTATION.]

## RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT.

Ocean Geophysics demonstrates relentless commitment to continuously developing its in-house
software, facilitated by a team of skilled in-house developers. The proliferation of autonomous
acquisition platforms and the increasing resolution of survey instruments have resulted in a
substantial growth of data volume.

Effectively interrogating, interpreting, and delivering these datasets demands significant
resources. Ocean Geophysics pushes the boundaries beyond industry-accepted data formats, enabling
more concise visualization for professional clients and non-technical audiences.

Through iterative evolution to meet the demands of the expanding geophysical survey industry, our
focus is on pioneering project delivery within allocated timelines and budgets, providing direct
benefits to our valued client base.

With a deep-rooted passion for research and development, our decades of industry experience form the
foundation of our expertise. Our accomplished team has authored peer-reviewed papers, delivered
training courses, executed complex and innovative projects, and continuously devises unique methods
to enhance and optimize businesses. Additionally, our synergistic collaboration with universities
empowers us to share industry knowledge with aspiring students and stay abreast of cutting-edge
technological advancements.

## RAISING INDUSTRY STANDARDS IN GLOBAL EXPEDITED
## GEOPHYSICAL PROJECT DELIVERY.

Ocean Geophysics is an independent geophysical data processing consultancy offering a global 24hr
service.

With over 100 years of combined experience in the design, acquisition, processing, reporting and
delivery of geophysical surveys.

Specialising in the processing and interpretation of Side Scan Sonar, Magnetometry, Gravity, CSEM,
Sub Bottom Profiler, Multibeam and Seismic data.

# WE PROVIDE A COMPLETE GEOPHYSICAL SOLUTION
# TAILORED TO YOUR PROJECT NEEDS.

[WE PROVIDE A COMPLETE GEOPHYSICAL SOLUTION]

## BORN OF THE IDEA THAT THE BEST DELIVERABLES COME FROM
## PROJECTS HANDLED BY A SINGLE TEAM.

Our in-house Ocean team has been expertly crafted to encompass exceptionally talented and
well-trained team members, capable of working in every data set.

Spearheaded by Robert Morrow and Eric Joyce, the Ocean Geophysics team is currently over 60
full-time members strong. Giving us the ability to work on large projects seamlessly.

We support multiple vessels with complete geophysical spread acquisition, with the ability to
provide 24-hour support. Ensuring that your data acquisition is smooth while aiding in the
minimisation of vessel downtime.

To use time zones effectively and to our advantage, we moved the whole company to South East Asia,
putting us 6 hours ahead of Europe and at least 12 hours ahead of most of the US.

This strategic move means that during operations, most processing and interpretation for clients in
the West takes place overnight.

## WE PRIDE OURSELVES IN OUR TEAMS ABILITY TO PROCESS DATA IN REAL TIME.
## PROVIDING 24-HOUR SUPPORT WHEN REQUIRED.

[Ocean team provides real time data]

## SERVICES OVERVIEW.

## DATA PROCESSING.

Ocean Geophysics is a leading provider of comprehensive data processing services in the field of
geophysics. With extensive expertise in Acquisition, Processing, and Interpretation, we specialize
in handling a wide range of geophysical data types.

Our skilled team is proficient in processing and analyzing various data sets, including Single and
Multi-Channel Seismic, 2D UHRS, 3D UHRS, Side Scan Sonar, Magnetometer and Gradiometer (UXO survey),
EM63 / 61, FTG, Resistivity and ALARP. By utilising advanced techniques and cutting-edge technology,
we ensure accurate and reliable results for our clients. 

[ LEARN MORE ][17]
[DATA PROCESSING.]

## CLIENT REPRESENTATION.

In today’s epoch of accelerated technology and critical review of contractor performance, effective
client representation plays a pivotal role in offshore operations. Ocean Geophysics understands this
significance and offers a comprehensive range of offshore client representation services.

With industry-leading professionals and a client-led approach, we cover a broad spectrum of
requirements, providing assurance and confidence. Our experienced operatives, combined with our
global 24-hour support services, ensure seamless assistance and prompt response.

[ LEARN MORE ][18]
[CLIENT REPRESENTATION.]

## RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT.

Ocean Geophysics demonstrates relentless commitment to continuously developing its in-house
software, facilitated by a team of skilled in-house developers. The proliferation of autonomous
acquisition platforms and the increasing resolution of survey instruments have resulted in a
substantial growth of data volume.

Effectively interrogating, interpreting, and delivering these datasets demands significant
resources. Ocean Geophysics pushes the boundaries beyond industry-accepted data formats, enabling
more concise visualization for professional clients and non-technical audiences.

Through iterative evolution to meet the demands of the expanding geophysical survey industry, our
focus is on pioneering project delivery within allocated timelines and budgets, providing direct
benefits to our valued client base.

With a deep-rooted passion for research and development, our decades of industry experience form the
foundation of our expertise. Our accomplished team has authored peer-reviewed papers, delivered
training courses, executed complex and innovative projects, and continuously devises unique methods
to enhance and optimize businesses. Additionally, our synergistic collaboration with universities
empowers us to share industry knowledge with aspiring students and stay abreast of cutting-edge
technological advancements.

# Bringing Clarity to Subsurface Data Management and Geoscience

**For more than 40 years, geoscientists, data managers and energy leaders worldwide have trusted
Petrosys Group to transform complex data into clear, confident decisions.** Our solutions help
organisations reduce costs, avoid duplication and unlock the full value of their data - from
processing and management through to integration, mapping and archiving. Grounded in a deep
understanding of the geoscience and data you work with, we’ve built software to support your
technical needs while remaining intuitive and easy to use.
[Talk with our team][33]
Number of Sites:  250+
 
Files Catalogued:  40 million
 
Petabytes of Data:  5,500

## Supporting Subsurface Data At Every Stage

[Interica OneView]

Interica OneView provides oversight of live and archived projects, helping teams understand what is
stored, reduce duplication, and manage costs while maintaining governance.

[Exploration Archives]

Exploration Archives specialises in large-scale digital preservation, automating ingestion,
indexing, and quality control to keep seismic repositories organised and searchable over time.

[dbMap]

dbMap provides an enterprise foundation for subsurface master data, bringing well, seismic, and
spatial information together into a single, governed source of truth.

[Exchange]

Exchange connects subsurface data, applications, and teams, enabling trusted collaboration across
disciplines while reducing silos and manual handoffs throughout the data lifecycle

[Interica DataCentre]

Interica DataCentre provides secure storage, cataloguing, and specialist data transformation
services for physical and digital subsurface media, ensuring critical energy data remains protected
and accessible.

[Claritas]

Claritas provides advanced seismic data processing for land and marine surveys, supporting efficient
workflows from acquisition through final imaging.

[PRO]

PRO supports consistent subsurface mapping and modeling, enabling teams to move from interpretation
to volumetric estimation with confidence, accuracy, and accountable results.

[GPinfo]

GPinfo provides trusted energy intelligence on a subscription basis, supporting exploration teams
with consistent, curated data for basin screening, evaluation, and decision-making.

## Powering Faster Discovery With Comprehensive Solutions

It takes many players working together to excel in the energy industry. That’s why we’ve developed
comprehensive subsurface data management and geoscience solutions that serve technical
decision-makers, data and information managers, executives and regulators.

storage efficiency.

decision-making.

### Data Integration & Exchange

workflows.
[Learn More][37]

### Seismic Data Processing

Efficiently process and image seismic data from acquisition through final interpretation-ready

[Learn More][38]

### Mapping & Modelling

Transform complex subsurface data and geological information into accurate, publication-quality maps
that display data and inspire action.
[Learn More][39]

RadExPro is seismic processing software for Windows, providing a comprehensive suite of
capabilities. From real-time seismic acquisition quality control (QC) and in-field processing to the
creation of final stacks, RadExPro simplifies every step of seismic data processing.

Many of our clients rely on RadExPro for comprehensive HR/UHR marine seismic processing,
encompassing both 2D and 3D data, benefiting from a suite of dedicated seismic processing algorithms
fine-tuned to address typical challenges associated with this type of data. These include efficient
adaptive deghosting, powerful multiple suppression, precise high-resolution marine statics, advanced
3D regularization, and pre-stack migration.

The Vertical Seismic Profile (VSP) processing facility within RadExPro offers extended support for
Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. It seamlessly handles data formats from all major
manufacturers of DAS equipment, providing real-time in-field QC and data analysis, as well as
conventional VSP processing.

RadExPro isn’t limited to marine applications. It’s your trusted companion for complete near-surface
land seismic data processing, including seismic reflection, refraction, and Multichannel Analysis of
Surface Waves (MASW).

With a development legacy dating back to 1992, RadExPro is trusted by hundreds of geophysical and
geotechnical companies, esteemed universities, and renowned research institutes. With a global
presence, RadExPro serves clients in more than 50 countries worldwide.

RadExPro has become our preferred processing software for 2D & 3D sparker multichannel data (UHRS)

# In–Depth Processing of HR/UHR Marine Seismic Data

RadExPro provides a complete solution for in–depth processing of HR/UHR marine seismic data
including advanced denoising, high–resolution offshore statics, designature (automatic wavelet
estimation, deghosting, debubbling, deconvolutions), efficient demultiple algorythms for
multi–channel (SRME) and even single–channel data (Zero–Offset Demultiple), 3D regularization,
pre–stack and post–stack migrations, etc.

Data on the picture is an ultra–high resolution (up to 3000 Hz) record acquired by [Geo Marine
Survey Systems][68] with a 48–channel streamer and a sparker source at 2–5 m water depths. Channel
spacing was 1 m, CDP interval—0.5 m. All the processing was made in RadExPro software by
[GeoSurveys][69].

[Learn More][70]

# SharpSeis Deghosting/Broadband Processing Solution

The algorithm utilize a stabilized approximate solution for the deghosting operator, applied to a
seismic trace in both forward and reversed time. The optimum ghost delay is estimated adaptively to
the data within a sliding window, to ensure the best possible match. This results in sharp
crystal–clear seismic images with broad spectrum and high signal–to–noise ratio.

Data on the picture is an airgun record courtesy of University of Tromsø.

[Learn More][71]

# Real–Time Marine Seismic QC

Real–time QC is dedicated for onboard seismic source and data quality control as soon as the data is
received during marine seismic acquisition. It is aimed to identify any problems with seismic
acquisition at the very same moment when they happen. This allows seismic crew to immediately fix
the problems, minimizing related loss of operational time and money. Nowadays RT QC is the industry
standard for marine seismic operations.

RadExPro Real–Time allows QC of the data from thousands of channels *in true real–time*, using just
