RadExPro is seismic processing software for Windows, providing a comprehensive suite of
capabilities. From real-time seismic acquisition quality control (QC) and in-field processing to the
creation of final stacks, RadExPro simplifies every step of seismic data processing.

Many of our clients rely on RadExPro for comprehensive HR/UHR marine seismic processing,
encompassing both 2D and 3D data, benefiting from a suite of dedicated seismic processing algorithms
fine-tuned to address typical challenges associated with this type of data. These include efficient
adaptive deghosting, powerful multiple suppression, precise high-resolution marine statics, advanced
3D regularization, and pre-stack migration.

The Vertical Seismic Profile (VSP) processing facility within RadExPro offers extended support for
Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. It seamlessly handles data formats from all major
manufacturers of DAS equipment, providing real-time in-field QC and data analysis, as well as
conventional VSP processing.

RadExPro isn’t limited to marine applications. It’s your trusted companion for complete near-surface
land seismic data processing, including seismic reflection, refraction, and Multichannel Analysis of
Surface Waves (MASW).

With a development legacy dating back to 1992, RadExPro is trusted by hundreds of geophysical and
geotechnical companies, esteemed universities, and renowned research institutes. With a global
presence, RadExPro serves clients in more than 50 countries worldwide.

# Our Clients about RadExPro

Honestly this software is well worth the price and will pay for itself in the first 5 week rotation.
It is definitely an excellent tool and I will recommend it be used on every crew I join. We have
identified electrical leakage, air leaks, autofires, misfires, loose hardware on gun plates,
oddities with PT/DTs etc. etc. Their support is excellent.

Fugro use RadExPro globally for the offshore quality control or our seismic data. The software is
both efficient and reliable, and the support provided by the team is excellent.

Fugro Survey Limited

We use RadExPro mostly for data analysis as it is highly versatile and gives the user flexibility to
build their own custom workflows using a variety of modules available. The header and trace
manipulation is only limited by the user’s creativity.

— Abhimanyu Yadav, Onboard Processing Support Geophysicist
Polarcus

RadExPro has become our preferred processing software for 2D & 3D sparker multichannel data (UHRS)
since the early of 2015. The reasons being that it has the full suite of processing modules for the
complete processing of our UHRS data; it is the only software in the market with the database
management and processing tools to resolve source and receiver motion with the vertical accuracy we
require; and lastly but not the least, RadExPro team has always provided prompt support and has
strived to meet our needs for new software tools and features.

— Henrique Duarte, Director of the Marine Department
GeoSurveys Consultants in Geophysics

MM–GEO Limited use RadExPro since 2008 mainly for field seismic acquisition QC, processing and
analysis of field trials and, in some case, for 2D data processing. We use it in acquisition
projects in Algeria, Libya, Ethiopia, Iraq and Western Siberia. Our geophysicists and supervisors
like RadExPro primarily because it is very handy and flexible and runs on conventional Windows
laptops.

We are also very happy to see how fast the software is being updated and improved, as well as how
prompt and responsive is the support team.

— Vyacheslav Marutyan, acting CEO
MM–GEO Limited

Having used RadExPro Professional for diverse near-surface research projects we can say that this
software package does a great job. Having this very ergonomic and reliable package of seismic
processing tools available is quite a technical plus point, either at fieldwork with QC–tools or
back at the office with the full variety of processing steps. Besides vibrator shearwave
applications we have been extensively using the MASW tools which worked amazingly well at even very
small geophone separations like 0.2 m—no number rounding problems!

Last not least to mention that RadExPro runs smoothly even on small notebook computers. This is
quite convenient while using the software for QC or any other application at field sites.

— Dr. Andreas F. Kathage, Managing Director
GeoHiRes International GmbH

We use RadExPro for processing of high–resolution marine seismic data. RadExPro is solid and gives
you complete freedom to work on the data. The software brings our, considered simple, single channel
data to a whole new level for QCing and processing.

— César Félix, Head of Technical Department
EGS Brasil

# In–Depth Processing of HR/UHR Marine Seismic Data

RadExPro provides a complete solution for in–depth processing of HR/UHR marine seismic data
including advanced denoising, high–resolution offshore statics, designature (automatic wavelet
estimation, deghosting, debubbling, deconvolutions), efficient demultiple algorythms for
multi–channel (SRME) and even single–channel data (Zero–Offset Demultiple), 3D regularization,
pre–stack and post–stack migrations, etc.

Data on the picture is an ultra–high resolution (up to 3000 Hz) record acquired by [Geo Marine
Survey Systems][68] with a 48–channel streamer and a sparker source at 2–5 m water depths. Channel
spacing was 1 m, CDP interval—0.5 m. All the processing was made in RadExPro software by
[GeoSurveys][69].

[Learn More][70]

# SharpSeis Deghosting/Broadband Processing Solution

The algorithm utilize a stabilized approximate solution for the deghosting operator, applied to a
seismic trace in both forward and reversed time. The optimum ghost delay is estimated adaptively to
the data within a sliding window, to ensure the best possible match. This results in sharp
crystal–clear seismic images with broad spectrum and high signal–to–noise ratio.

Data on the picture is an airgun record courtesy of University of Tromsø.

[Learn More][71]

# Real–Time Marine Seismic QC

Real–time QC is dedicated for onboard seismic source and data quality control as soon as the data is
received during marine seismic acquisition. It is aimed to identify any problems with seismic
acquisition at the very same moment when they happen. This allows seismic crew to immediately fix
the problems, minimizing related loss of operational time and money. Nowadays RT QC is the industry
standard for marine seismic operations.

RadExPro Real–Time allows QC of the data from thousands of channels *in true real–time*, using just
an average good modern PC with a multi–core CPU and 64–bit Windows OS. Compare this to some other
known packages, which are supposed to run procedures in the real–time, while on practice have dozens
of shots delayed even working on a Linux cluster…

### About us

The well-established team making the basis of our company has been created during more than 25 years
of effective collaborative work in the fields of research, geophysical software development and
seismic data processing.

[More][49]

### Services

Using the modern Prime software system developed in our company, Seismotech provides a unique set of
services including all the required components for seismic data processing.

[More][50]

### Prime

We have developed the Prime software system designed for interactive interpretative processing of
seismic data, which involves:

[More][51]
* More than 25 years of development
* Over 140 tools
* Experience in more than 100 offshore and onshore projects

### Efficiency

The example of processing productivity in one of the completed offshore projects (1 500 km², 10 TB
of data):

[More][52]
* Data loading: 24 hours
* 3D SRMP and 3D SRME: 30 days
* Data sorting: 20 minutes

### Prime Cloud

**Enables full seismic data processing graph on cloud computing resources.**

Prime Cloud virtual cluster deployment takes several minutes, its configuration can be modified in
the course of operation depending on the required performance.

[More][53]
* Short time frames for project implementation
* High computing performance
* Cost optimisation

# Prime software

**Prime** is a software for an interpretative processing of 2D/3D/4D/3C/4C onshore and offshore
wide-azimuth or narrow-azimuth complex seismic data. The software includes solutions for the
heterogeneous upper part compensation, salt domes, strongly dislocated tectonics, shallow and
transit zones, wave field transformation, demultiple, deghosting and much more technologies.

Prime has been developed as a link between processing and interpretation and provides advanced
technologies for interpretative seismic data processing. These technologies give the possibilities
to account for a priori information, process data in depth domain and operate with interval
velocities starting from the first stages of a project.

[More][54]

## News

[
April 5th, 2026

### Happy Geologists’ Day!

][55]

## Events

[
June 16-17, 2026

### Seismotech will take part at a joint report at the conference "The Potential of the North of
### Western Siberia: Resources and Technologies"

][56]

The company provides sales of non-exclusive licenses of Prime software, as well as technical support
services for Prime software, interpretative processing of seismic data on the basis of its own
software and consulting in the field of seismic data processing. In this area, the company provides
services in research and development and software development for the Customer's tasks. The detailed
information about the company's services please find[in the Services section][57].

The cost of simple non-exclusive licenses of Prime software is calculated individually and is
determined by the user company's requirements to the technological process of processing (the number
of users and technical characteristics of the hardware to be used, as well as the purchase of
additional technological solutions included in Prime software but supplied separately). The cost of
Seismotech services is calculated on request for specific projects according to the complexity and
duration of the tasks to be performed, as well as the resources involved. To estimate the cost,
please contact the Commercial Director of Seismotech, Ltd. company [mail@seismotech.ru][58]

technologies for interpretative seismic data processing. These technologies give the possibilities
to account for a priori information, process data in depth domain and operate with interval
velocities starting from the first stages of a project.

[Certainty icon – aligned bars and shapes illustrating tools for clarifying risk factors and

Tools for clarifying risk factors and reducing uncertainty, so you reach accurate, trustable

## Access terabyte-size datasets

[Terabyte-size dataset icon – representing access to massive seismic volumes on the Sharp
Reflections platform]

Your decisions begin at the source, with fast and painless access to your entire prestack dataset.
Now, huge multidimensional datasets are an asset instead of a roadblock, helping you gain deeper
subsurface understanding.

The Sharp Reflections software empowers data processors and interpreters to work collaboratively in
one space—seamlessly, anytime—to curate full-fidelity images of your prospects, discover new
prospects, and make accurate predrill decisions.

### After stacking, it’s too late to fix things

Imagine the clarity and certainty you gain when you can refine your entire source dataset, anytime
you want.

Envision your teams zooming in and out of your prestack data, fine tuning parameters and comparing
results. Geophysical interpreters can improve image quality and resolution in real time. Analysts
can calibrate amplitudes to wells, and tune data to reveal new prospects, improve reservoir models,
and monitor production in existing fields. None of the forced shortcuts or compromises caused by

## We took a bold step

When Sharp Reflections entered the scene a decade ago, we saw thousands of terabytes of data
flooding in from every seismic acquisition—volumes way beyond anything that standard desktop
computing can handle to this day.

We thought about this immense data volume and said: we can do more with that, and we can do it
faster.

It took nerve, but we knew it could be done. So we built the tools to do it.

[Read our story][17]

### Smarter. Faster. Sharper.

We took a fresh approach, harnessing the power of clustered, HPC to interrogate full-fidelity
seismic gathers before they are stacked.

Our unique, in-memory computing engine delivers a quantum leap forward in desktop processing speed
and interactivity. Advanced visualization, processing and analytical tools help interpreters extract
every bit of information possible from the entire 3D survey.

[Discover our HPC edge][18]

### More information.
### Less uncertainty.

Better data is not the end goal. We know you want to squeeze out as much information as you can, as
quickly as possible.

Yet, despite steady advances in imaging algorithms, true amplitudes are rarely achieved the first
time around. Inaccurate reservoir predictions are a direct result of noise and other artifacts that
are locked into the final angle stacks.

Precision seismic processing and analysis are essential for rock and fluid property prediction.
Drill or drop? What is the best well location? What’s the uncertainty in the predictions? Where are
the risks? With the Sharp Reflections toolkit, you can glide between prestack and poststack and back
again to optimize results for all of your important decisions.

[Find solutions][19]

### Richer datasets for deeper insight

Big data keeps getting bigger with new and more frequent acquisition techniques. We offer a full
suite of flexible analysis tools to help you transform data into insight.

Our tools automate and accelerate analysis of multi-azimuth and multivintage seismic data, and help
interpreters unlock the full value of their surveys and projects. Automation improves productivity,
so your team can spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time making sense of the data.

one space—seamlessly, anytime—to curate full-fidelity images of your prospects, discover new
prospects, and make accurate predrill decisions.

you want.

incomplete data.

### Solar Activity

URSIgram 2026-07-24

Solar flaring activity was low over the past 24 hours with only C-class flares identified. A total
of 6 numbered sunspot groups were identified on the visible solar disk. The strongest activity was a
C2.8 flare (SIDC Flare 8260) peaking on July 23 at 15:12 UTC with estimated location S19E19. The
flaring was not associated with any of the observed active regions. SIDC Sunspot Group 920 (NOAA
Active Region 4493), currently located at N05W36, continues to be the largest region, classified as
magnetic type beta-gamma. It has produced only low C-class flaring. SIDC Sunspot Group 886 (NOAA
Active Region 4494), currently located at S02E34, has exhibited some flux emergence and growth and
is now classified as magnetic type beta-delta. It has contributed to the low levels of activity.
SIDC Sunspot Group 916 (NOAA Active Region 4489, magnetic type alpha) currently located at S07W71
has also produced an isolated low C-class flaring. SIDC Sunspot Group 923, currently located at
N05E71, has rotated from over the east limb and is classified as magnetic type beta. It has been
quiet. The remaining active regions are simple and have remained quiet. The solar flaring activity
is expected to be at low to moderate levels over the next 24 hours with likely M-class flaring. No
Earth-directed coronal mass ejections (CMEs) have been identified in the available coronagraph
imagery over the past 24 hours. A slow and faint CME (SIDC CME 699) was first observed in LASCO/C2
coronagraph imagery around 04:49 UTC and in STEREO/COR2 around 04:38 UTC on July 24. The eruption
appears associated with a C2.4 flaring and a weak dimming near S21E09. The bulk of the CME appears
headed away from the Sun-Earth line. A minor glancing blow influence might be possible on July 28,
but due to the weak nature of the CME it might be difficult to distinguish it in the solar wind
data. Over the past 24 hours the greater than 10 MeV GOES proton flux was at nominal levels and is
expected to remain so over the 24 hours. The greater than 2 MeV electron flux as measured by GOES 18
and GOES 19 was below the 1000 pfu threshold over the past 24 hours and is expected to exceed the
1000 pfu threshold over the next 24 hours and the following days. The 24-hour electron fluence was
at nominal levels and is expected to remain at nominal levels over the 24 hours and increase to
moderate levels in the days after.

### Solar Wind

URSIgram 2026-07-24

The geomagnetic conditions over the past 24 hours have varied from quiet to minor storms levels with
NOAA Kp index reaching values of 5+ and 5 in the intervals between 15 and 21 UTC on July 23. Quiet
to active conditions were registered so far on July 24 and predominantly quiet to active conditions
are expected to prevail over the next 24 hours with small chances for isolated minor storms in case
of prolonged periods with negative Bz. Predominantly quiet to unsettled conditions are expected on
July 25 and a predominantly quiet conditions are expected on July 26 and July 27. Over the past 24
hours the solar wind parameters (as measured by ACE at L1) have registered an increase in the solar
wind speed mostly likely reflecting the previously expected pristine high speed stream arrival
related to the negative polarity SIDC Coronal Hole 142. The solar wind speed increased up to 748
km/s. The interplanetary magnetic field (B) remained moderately elevated with a maximum magnitude of
10.8 nT and a minimum north-south (Bz) component of - 8.5 nT. The B field phi angle remained
predominantly in the negative sector (directed towards the Sun) reflecting the polarity of the
geo-effective coronal hole. The solar wind parameters over the next 24 hours are expected to remain
enhanced under the influence of the ongoing high-speed stream arrival.

# Experience & Innovation

For 30 years, Sterling Seismic has been at the forefront of seismic data processing in the oil and
gas industry. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction has established us as
a trusted leader.

# Industry Expertise

Our Geophysicists have a combined 250 years of experience, and together they cover every basin and
technique.

# Extensive Geographic Coverage

Sterling Seismic has processed more than 28,000 land seismic projects in all US Basins over the last
3 decades.

# 250+ Years

Combined Faculty Geophysical
Experience

# All Basins

Our team has extensive experience across every major basin in the US

# 4,400+

In-house hardware with over 4,400 core & 480TB of storage

# 1,000+

Several 1,000+ square mile multiple merge surveys

# Services

## Advanced Capabilities, Strategic Approach

Sterling offers comprehensive Seismic Processing services for 2D, 3D, 4D, and multi-component land
data worldwide. Our advanced capabilities ensure precision and efficiency in data interpretation and
analysis. Our strategic approach empowers clients to make informed decisions, optimize operations,
and maximize project potential.
[Learn More][29]

# Technologies

## Maximize Investment & Advantage

Game-changing technologies make a critical difference for E&P companies seeking to improve their
understanding of the subsurface. Technical solutions and collaboration from start to end with
Sterling allow our clients to maximize their investment in seismic data and gain an advantage in
exploring and developing their reservoirs.
[Learn More][30]

# Reprocessed Data, Revitalized Insights

Sterling has revitalized hundreds of datasets for clients over the past five years, significantly
enhancing data utility and providing deeper insights.
Our strategic approach refines exploration strategies and operational plans, ensuring every decision
is backed by the most accurate and up-to-date information.
[Get More From Your Data][31]

# The Sterling Advantage

Our expert Geophysicists deliver accurate, high-quality, and reliable seismic data to help our
clients gain a competitive edge.

# Industry-Leading Experience

Our Geophysicists have a deep understanding of every basin in the US, backed by extensive processing
and project experience.
[Our Experts][32]

# Turnaround Time

Our unique workflow is twice as fast as the industry standard, allowing us to deliver top-quality
results swiftly.
[Our Approach][33]

# In-House Technology

Our extensive in-house software and servers ensure that your data is processed efficiently,
accurately, and securely.
[Our Tech][34]

# Client Collaboration

Our Geophysicists prioritize communication with our clients, resulting in increased accuracy &
reduced inefficiencies.
[Our Philosophy][35]

# with a Senior Geophysicist

Partner with us for the fastest, most reliable seismic data processing services in the industry.
We look forward to collaborating.

# Experience & Innovation

For 30 years, Sterling Seismic has been at the forefront of seismic data processing in the oil and
gas industry. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction has established us as
a trusted leader.

# Industry Expertise

Our Geophysicists have a combined 250 years of experience, and together they cover every basin and
technique.

# Extensive Geographic Coverage

Sterling Seismic has processed more than 28,000 land seismic projects in all US Basins over the last
3 decades.

# 250+ Years

Combined Faculty Geophysical
Experience

# 175,000+

100,000+ 2D miles & 75,000+ 3D sq. miles processed in-house

# All Basins

Our team has extensive experience across every major basin in the US

# 4,400+

In-house hardware with over 4,400 core & 480TB of storage

# 1,000+

Several 1,000+ square mile multiple merge surveys

# Services

## Advanced Capabilities, Strategic Approach

Sterling offers comprehensive Seismic Processing services for 2D, 3D, 4D, and multi-component land
data worldwide. Our advanced capabilities ensure precision and efficiency in data interpretation and
analysis. Our strategic approach empowers clients to make informed decisions, optimize operations,
and maximize project potential.
[Learn More][29]

# Technologies

## Maximize Investment & Advantage

Game-changing technologies make a critical difference for E&P companies seeking to improve their
understanding of the subsurface. Technical solutions and collaboration from start to end with
Sterling allow our clients to maximize their investment in seismic data and gain an advantage in
exploring and developing their reservoirs.
[Learn More][30]

# Reprocessed Data, Revitalized Insights

Sterling has revitalized hundreds of datasets for clients over the past five years, significantly
enhancing data utility and providing deeper insights.
Our strategic approach refines exploration strategies and operational plans, ensuring every decision
is backed by the most accurate and up-to-date information.
[Get More From Your Data][31]

# The Sterling Advantage

Our expert Geophysicists deliver accurate, high-quality, and reliable seismic data to help our
clients gain a competitive edge.

# Industry-Leading Experience

Our Geophysicists have a deep understanding of every basin in the US, backed by extensive processing
and project experience.
[Our Experts][32]

# Turnaround Time

Our unique workflow is twice as fast as the industry standard, allowing us to deliver top-quality
results swiftly.
[Our Approach][33]

# In-House Technology

Our extensive in-house software and servers ensure that your data is processed efficiently,
accurately, and securely.
[Our Tech][34]

# Client Collaboration

Our Geophysicists prioritize communication with our clients, resulting in increased accuracy &
reduced inefficiencies.
[Our Philosophy][35]

## The benefits of using STRYDE

[STRYDE D]

#### Low-cost seismic data acquisition

Reduce the overall cost of seismic acquisition with compact, lightweight nodes that require less
equipment, fewer field interventions, reduced crew time, and simpler logistics across the full
survey lifecycle.

[STRYDE D]

#### Rapid access to high-quality seismic data

Acquire high-density seismic data faster with nodes that are quick to deploy, easy to bury for
optimal coupling, and designed to support improved data quality across large-scale surveys.

[Untitled design 25]

#### Simpler logistics, faster surveys

With lightweight equipment, 50+ days of autonomy, and rapid charging and data harvesting, STRYDE
nodes help reduce vehicle movements, equipment handling, crew time, and operational complexity.

[STRYDE D]

#### Long deployment times

50+ days of node autonomy supports longer recording windows with fewer field interventions, helping
crews keep surveys running efficiently while reducing downtime and operational disruption.

[STRYDE D]

#### Near-zero environmental impact

Meet tightening environmental requirements without sacrificing survey performance. The world's
smallest seismic node reduces vehicle movements, land disturbance, and overall footprint, enabling
high-density acquisition with minimal impact.

[STRYDE D]

#### Accelerate node turnaround and redeployment

Simultaneous charging and data harvesting enables fast turnaround, with just one hour required for
every ten days of recording - helping crews redeploy batches of nodes quickly and keep operations
moving.

[STRYDE node families]

From oil and gas exploration to geothermal development and mineral discovery, STRYDE enables

## The benefits of using STRYDE

[STRYDE D]

#### Low-cost seismic data acquisition

Reduce the overall cost of seismic acquisition with compact, lightweight nodes that require less
equipment, fewer field interventions, reduced crew time, and simpler logistics across the full
survey lifecycle.

[STRYDE D]

#### Rapid access to high-quality seismic data

Acquire high-density seismic data faster with nodes that are quick to deploy, easy to bury for
optimal coupling, and designed to support improved data quality across large-scale surveys.

[Untitled design 25]

#### Simpler logistics, faster surveys

With lightweight equipment, 50+ days of autonomy, and rapid charging and data harvesting, STRYDE
nodes help reduce vehicle movements, equipment handling, crew time, and operational complexity.

[STRYDE D]

#### Long deployment times

50+ days of node autonomy supports longer recording windows with fewer field interventions, helping
crews keep surveys running efficiently while reducing downtime and operational disruption.

[STRYDE D]

#### Near-zero environmental impact

Meet tightening environmental requirements without sacrificing survey performance. The world's
smallest seismic node reduces vehicle movements, land disturbance, and overall footprint, enabling
high-density acquisition with minimal impact.

[STRYDE D]

#### Accelerate node turnaround and redeployment

Simultaneous charging and data harvesting enables fast turnaround, with just one hour required for
every ten days of recording - helping crews redeploy batches of nodes quickly and keep operations
moving.

[STRYDE node families]

In 2016, bp, Rosneft Oil Company and WesternGeco AS agreed to collaborate to develop a new “nimble
node” for land seismic acquisition. In August 2019, bp formed STRYDE to commercialise the resulting
technology.

On 30^{th} Dec 2024, STRYDE Holdings Ltd completed the acquisition of STRYDE Limited (STRYDE) from
bp Launchpad. STRYDE Holdings Ltd is owned by current employees of STRYDE.

# Check your risk

Find insurance, retrofit, and data solutions for your earthquake, flood, wildfire, liquefaction,
landslide, and tsunami risks.

[[Download Temblor in the App Store]][33][[Get Temblor on Google Play]][34][[Temblor is also
available in a Web-App]][35]

### About Temblor

Temblor, Inc. is a catastrophe modeling company specializing in seismic hazard and risk assessment.
Founded in 2014 by former USGS scientists Ross Stein and Volkan Sevilgen, Temblor’s mission is to
raise awareness of seismic risk. We serve the insurance, reinsurance and insurance-linked security
communities, and mortgage lenders.

Temblor is different from other cat modelers. Our models build on recent published and
independently-tested scientific analyses to provide an independent, unbiased, and transparent
assessment of risk. Our products include dynamic hazard and loss forecasts after large earthquakes;
the first globally consistent insurance loss model; stochastic event sets; and the
highest-resolution global site amplification model available today. Additionally, we calculate a
building-level Temblor Earthquake Score, which folds in all factors that impact loss into one number
for risk pricing and selection.

Temblor provides both its clients and the public with accurate, accessible, and understandable
information about earthquakes. Temblor Earthquake News publishes breaking earthquake news, in-depth
analyses, and expert reporting on the latest developments in natural hazards research. Our articles
are written by scientists, science journalists, and leading international researchers.

# Check your risk

Find insurance, retrofit, and data solutions for your earthquake, flood, wildfire, liquefaction,
landslide, and tsunami risks.

[[Download Temblor in the App Store]][33][[Get Temblor on Google Play]][34][[Temblor is also
available in a Web-App]][35]

### About Temblor

Temblor, Inc. is a catastrophe modeling company specializing in seismic hazard and risk assessment.
Founded in 2014 by former USGS scientists Ross Stein and Volkan Sevilgen, Temblor’s mission is to
raise awareness of seismic risk. We serve the insurance, reinsurance and insurance-linked security
communities, and mortgage lenders.

Temblor is different from other cat modelers. Our models build on recent published and
independently-tested scientific analyses to provide an independent, unbiased, and transparent
assessment of risk. Our products include dynamic hazard and loss forecasts after large earthquakes;
the first globally consistent insurance loss model; stochastic event sets; and the
highest-resolution global site amplification model available today. Additionally, we calculate a
building-level Temblor Earthquake Score, which folds in all factors that impact loss into one number
for risk pricing and selection.

Temblor provides both its clients and the public with accurate, accessible, and understandable
information about earthquakes. Temblor Earthquake News publishes breaking earthquake news, in-depth
analyses, and expert reporting on the latest developments in natural hazards research. Our articles
are written by scientists, science journalists, and leading international researchers.

##### FROM GROUNDWATER TO PERMAFROST

## Explore Applications

#### Managed Aquifer Recharge –

Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) is a way of replenishing underground water supplies by intentionally
storing water in aquifers. This is done by directing surface water, stormwater, or treated
wastewater into the ground.

#### Fractured Hard Rock –

Fractured hard rock refers to rock types like granite or basalt that have cracked or broken due to
natural processes such as tectonic movements, weathering, or even drilling.

[Borehole Siting - Togo][91]

#### Saltwater Intrusion –

Saltwater intrusion happens when seawater enters freshwater aquifers or coastal groundwater systems.
This is caused by over-extraction of groundwater, rising sea levels, and natural changes.

#### Weathered Bedrock –

Weathered bedrock is the layer of rock beneath the soil that has undergone various weathering
processes, including chemical, physical, and biological breakdown.

#### Permafrost Mapping –

Permafrost is ground that remains frozen for at least two consecutive years, consisting of soil,
rock, and organic material bound by ice. Found in polar and high-altitude regions.

mineral deposits through fast single-site measurements, all controlled from our Android or iOS app.

Our vision is based on the belief that informed resource management is crucial for addressing the
increasing vulnerability of groundwater to climate change.

###### [Read the full story here.. ][90]

##### FROM GROUNDWATER TO PERMAFROST

## Explore Applications

#### Managed Aquifer Recharge –

Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) is a way of replenishing underground water supplies by intentionally
storing water in aquifers. This is done by directing surface water, stormwater, or treated
wastewater into the ground.

#### Fractured Hard Rock –

Fractured hard rock refers to rock types like granite or basalt that have cracked or broken due to
natural processes such as tectonic movements, weathering, or even drilling.

[Borehole Siting - Togo][91]

#### Saltwater Intrusion –

Saltwater intrusion happens when seawater enters freshwater aquifers or coastal groundwater systems.
This is caused by over-extraction of groundwater, rising sea levels, and natural changes.

#### Weathered Bedrock –

Weathered bedrock is the layer of rock beneath the soil that has undergone various weathering
processes, including chemical, physical, and biological breakdown.

#### Permafrost Mapping –

Permafrost is ground that remains frozen for at least two consecutive years, consisting of soil,
rock, and organic material bound by ice. Found in polar and high-altitude regions.

##### GROUNDWATER, MAR, AND CRITICAL MINERAL MAPPING

## sTEM - accurate and affordable

Reach beyond 500 m (1,650 ft) with the modular sTEM scanner. Map groundwater reserves and critical
mineral deposits through fast single-site measurements, all controlled from our Android or iOS app.

[**Explore the sTEM family**][92]

## Why use Zenodo?
* **Safe** — Your research is stored safely for the future in CERN’s Data Centre for as long as CERN
  exists
* **Trusted** — Built and operated by CERN and OpenAIRE to ensure that everyone can join in Open
  Science
* **Citeable** — Every upload is assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), to make them citable
  and trackable
* **No waiting time** — Uploads are made available online as soon as you hit publish, and your DOI
  is registered within seconds
* **Open or closed** — Share e.g. anonymized clinical trial data with only medical professionals via
  our restricted access mode
* **Versioning** — Easily update your dataset with our versioning feature
* **GitHub integration** — Easily preserve your GitHub repository in Zenodo
* **Usage statistics** — All uploads display standards compliant usage statistics

## Why use Zenodo?
* **Safe** — Your research is stored safely for the future in CERN’s Data Centre for as long as CERN
  exists
* **Trusted** — Built and operated by CERN and OpenAIRE to ensure that everyone can join in Open
  Science
* **Citeable** — Every upload is assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), to make them citable
  and trackable
* **No waiting time** — Uploads are made available online as soon as you hit publish, and your DOI
  is registered within seconds
* **Open or closed** — Share e.g. anonymized clinical trial data with only medical professionals via
  our restricted access mode
* **Versioning** — Easily update your dataset with our versioning feature
* **GitHub integration** — Easily preserve your GitHub repository in Zenodo
* **Usage statistics** — All uploads display standards compliant usage statistics

South Korea’s power mix is still coal heavy, with 43.3% generated from coal in 2023, even as
